ROUTING BLIND SPOT: cors-auth-lock.test.mjs and route-completeness.test.mjs were aimed at index.js. WRONG. ALL CORS/CSRF/security headers/quota enforcement lives in router.js (Hono entry point). A cors-auth test reading index.js false-passes vacuously. FIX: cors-auth MUST read router.js. route-completeness reads BOTH router.js AND index.js. Corrected in run105-audit-addendum.md.

RUN 106 MASTERWORK — 5 PHASES: Phase 0 (Truth Lock): P10 defects A-D closed, 15 locks corrected + wired, real F1-B proof, offboarded PII purge, password hardening, behavioral test foundation. Phase I (Fortress): encryption at rest, hard Clerk auth, GDPR export, audit integrity. Phase II (Kill Monolith): strangler-fig index.js → src/routes/ voice-first, behavioral equivalence tests. Phase III (Living Memory): buildLongitudinalContext for all sessions, student DNA pipeline. Phase IV (Scale Engine): roster-as-data, portal template, provision-student.mjs. Phase V (Apex): APEX seal per phase, COLD-START-BOOT reconcile.

THE GAUNTLET 7 STAGES: Stage 0 = node --check + 15 locks + gitleaks (pre-commit, blocks bad commits physically). Stage 1 = vitest-pool-workers behavioral (already installed, UNUSED — biggest depth upgrade available). Stage 2 = fast-check property fuzzing. Stage 3 = route-completeness + api-smoke on dev. Stage 4 = Playwright 3-mode + a11y. Stage 5 = load test BOTH sov100-test-magic AND keep-warm-ping. Stage 6 = live prod canary full voice journey, 2 RED → auto-rollback. Stage 7 = Stryker mutation (weekly, grades the suite).

FULLSTACK ARCHITECTURE MAP: Chrome Extension → /api/deepgram-token (router.js quota gate) → index.js handler (assertVoiceBrainLock×2, cache hit/miss, phonicsHint, ws_url syd for vi) → returns {token=rawKey, settings={think=gpt-4o-mini,listen=nova-3,speak=aura-2-zeus-en}, ws_url, greeting, phonicsHint}. Extension opens ws_url with raw token (VOICE-EC-3 never JWT). Settings applied via UpdateSettings. Student memory in STUDENT_MEMORY mem:<id> (Dreamer). Operator soul in SOUL_DB soul_prompts.

OB-1 NEVER SELF-CERTIFIES. OB-1 specifies the receipt (exact command + exact pass signal). Kilo runs it and pastes. 'Should pass' is not a receipt. This is the structural fix for the ghost-closure failure mode from Run 105.
